name: Alberto Pecchini
tagline: Construction & Land Management student · Front-end Developer · Available for web design, front-end development and branding
profile: CAT graduate (Construction, Environment and Territory) and Construction and Land Management student at the University of Modena and Reggio Emilia, a self-taught front-end developer & designer.
